reviews.A1: Consistency in submitting assignments within the expected period of time (meeting the deadline)
reviews.A2: Ability to produce reliable work quality by being thorough with minimum errors.
reviews.A3: Ability to work under minimum supervision.
reviews.A4: Ability to be active and consistent in seeking knowledge/information needed to perform the job.
reviews.A5: Ability to analyze/identify the main issues/problems.
reviews.A6: Ability to offer relevant solutions/recommendations to problems.
reviews.A7: Level of discipline to maintain agreed working hours.
reviews.A8: Level of awareness of organizational code of conduct and culture.
reviews.B1: Ability to prioritize team goals over individual goals.
reviews.B2: Ability to accept constructive feedback from team members or supervisors in a mature and professional manner.
reviews.B3: Level of initiative to seek information on team needs and act on it.
reviews.B4: Level of awareness of customer needs, expectations, problems, and circumstances.
reviews.B5: Ability to build rapport and cooperation with customers.
reviews.B6: Level of engagement with team members (including attending discussions, being helpful, and showing empathy).
reviews.B7: Ability to share important/relevant information (including ideas and recent updates) with team members and supervisors.
reviews.C1: Ability to behave in a respectful and consistent manner.
reviews.C2: Ability to share feelings to let colleagues understand current state of mind.
reviews.C4: Ability to treat other people with respect.
reviews.C5: Ability to maintain constant performance and act rationally under stressful situations.
reviews.C6: Ability to adjust to emerging changes in the workplace.
reviews.D1: Ability to listen and follow instructions.
reviews.D2: Ability to convey clear messages and information in good spoken language.
reviews.D3: Ability to write clearly and concisely.
reviews.D4: Ability to respond to questions, feedback, and instructions in a clear and correct manner.
reviews.D5: Level of relevancy of knowledge to business needs.

onboarding.dashboardDescSupervisor: See team-wide metrics, attendance trends, task completion, and a leaderboard of top performers at a glance.
